user.title: iNELS central unit (CU3)
user.description:
Enter the unit's address. Nothing has to be enabled in iNELS IDM3 first — the integration uses the same interface IDM3 itself does, which every central unit answers on.

Leave the export file path empty to download the device list from the unit. Firmware that does not serve it over HTTP has no export to download — save the iNELS3 export in IDM3 and drop the file into the upload field instead.

data.export_file: Export file path (leave empty to download)
data.export_upload: Export file upload (drop the .is3 file here)

data_description.port: Only change this if the unit is reached through a tunnel or a forwarded port.
data_description.password: The password set on the central unit in IDM3. Leave empty if none is set, which is the usual case.

reconfigure.title: iNELS central unit (CU3)
reconfigure.description: Update how Home Assistant reaches the unit. Leave the export file path empty to download the device list from the unit, or drop a fresh export file into the upload field.

data.export_file: Export file path (leave empty to download)
data.export_upload: Export file upload (drop the .is3 file here)

data_description.port: Only change this if the unit is reached through a tunnel or a forwarded port.
data_description.password: The password set on the central unit in IDM3. Leave empty if none is set.

reauth_confirm.title: iNELS central unit (CU3)
reauth_confirm.description: The central unit is no longer accepting the stored password. Enter the current one.

data_description.password: The password set on the central unit in IDM3. Leave empty if none is set.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the central unit. Check the address, and that Home Assistant can reach the unit's network.
error.invalid_auth: The central unit refused that password.
error.password_required: This central unit has a password set. Enter it.
error.export_protected: This unit will not hand over its export. Upload the export file, or enter the path to a local copy.
error.export_unavailable: This unit does not serve its export over HTTP -- newer CU3 firmware does not. Upload the export file from iNELS Designer Manager, or enter the path to a copy on this machine.
error.invalid_export: The export could not be read or contains no entries

abort.already_configured: This central unit is already configured
abort.wrong_unit: That address is a different central unit than this entry. Add it as a new integration instead.

export_protected.title: IS3 Export can't download the device list
export_protected.description:
The central unit will not serve its export file, so Home Assistant cannot refresh the list of devices.

Save the iNELS3 export from IDM3 and upload it: Settings → Devices & services → IS3 Export → ⋮ → Reconfigure. The unit's own password does not affect this.
